I drafted and sent four disputes for owner approval, covering $79.15 in deductions. One case, DD-51102, is weak and needs a ticket photo from you before I can do anything with it.

**Sent**

| Case | Amount | Win probability | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| DD-51152 | $28.40 | 90% | The ticket lists only Veg Momo (Steamed) and Samosa Chaat, not the claimed Chicken Thukpa. The order was ready at 20:26 and picked up at 20:29. |
| DD-51123 | $14.25 | 90% | The ticket lists Veg Momo (Fried). The order was ready at 18:36 and picked up at 18:40. |
| DD-51115 | $17.50 | 80% | The ticket lists Jhol Momo. The order was ready at 12:55 and picked up at 12:58. |
| DD-51131 | $19.00 | 77% | The ticket lists Chicken Momo (Steamed). The order was ready at 19:31 and picked up at 19:34. |

- **What the tickets show:** They show what was prepared, not what was packed. The drafts say only what the tickets and times show.
- **Repeat claims:** One account made three claims this period (DD-51123, DD-51131 and DD-51140). I kept that out of the disputes so nothing reads as an accusation.
- **DD-51152 carries some risk:** Past history is 2 wins and 1 loss on similar missing-item claims. The loss involved an item that wasn't on the ticket. DD-51152 has the same feature, so don't treat 90% as certain.

**Weak**
- **DD-51102 ($46.80, 35%):** No order ticket is on file, so I can't show what was prepared. Send me a photo of the ticket and I'll re-run the evidence check. It's the largest deduction, so it's worth the effort.

**Not examined yet**
- **DD-51140 ($13.75, 60%) and DD-51160 ($9.50, 60%):** I only looked at the top five cases. I can check these next.

**Skipped**
- **DD-51171 ($11.00, 15%):** Not worth your time.
- **DD-50980 ($0.00):** It's past its deadline and the amount is $0.

The next deadline is **2026-11-24**, 10 days out, and it applies to every open case. I saved the case notes in `/plan.md`.
